findings.reason: At an exact multiple of 10^6 the `other` arm renders « 1000000 agents intégrés », where French requires « d’agents intégrés »; 187 of the fr catalogue’s 190 plural messages carry one/many/other, so this is a conformance gap, not a house style. It is a nit because the offer count is bounded by the packaged built-in profiles and the =0 arm is gated at the call site (availableBuiltins.length > 0), so no user can reach the count that exposes it.
